amendment.summary: The pre-registered phrase 'both-directions-correct also leaves chance' fixed no numeric null. It is operationalised post-run as a usable independent decision: balanced canonical AND balanced swap accuracy must each clear 0.5 with a Wilson 95% lower bound above 0.5, and full-set independent must beat the locked control. This is not part of the exact pre-registered numerical rule.

config.init_checkpoint_absent.contract: key must be absent from the config

provenance_check.note: Validated by key membership, not value coercion: a required field whose expected value is False or None still fails when absent. Any missing or mismatched field forces 'indeterminate'.

prediction_provenance_check.id_policy: strict equality: the set of prediction ids must equal the set of required suite-rendering ids. Extras are reported and fail the check; they are never silently ignored.
prediction_provenance_check.note: Expected pair counts are derived from the loaded admissible suite, not hard-coded. Duplicate ids are detected on the raw row list before dictionary construction, in linear time. Any failure forces 'indeterminate'.

provenance.purpose: Arc 2 Q1: train from the base 3B + fresh LoRA on split_view only. Glyph channel never seen. Same 2208-pair polarity-balanced set and 4-epoch compute as the locked curve, without inheriting glyph-exposed weights.

checkpoint_identity.note: Checkpoint identity only. Checkpoint weights are local, are not committed, and are deliberately not hashed here.

publication_blocking_reasons: gitignored inputs (not reconstructible from a fresh clone): ['predictions', 'suite']
working tree is dirty, so the recorded commit does not describe the materialized evidence
checkpoint weights are local and unverified by any hash (release limitation, not a defect)
reproducibility.local_analysis_reproducible_note: true when every input the analysis consumed is present locally and matches its recorded hash. This says nothing about whether a fresh clone could reproduce it.
reproducibility.publication_readiness_note: false. A passing local --check-only proves the local files match their hashes; it does NOT make the artifact fresh-clone reproducible. Gitignored suite and prediction inputs, a dirty tree, and analysis code that the recorded commit does not contain each independently block a reconstructible release chain. See publication_blockers.

verdict.pre_registered_rule: Failure if balanced independent stays at chance OR the full-set independent point estimate does not exceed the locked 0.8502 reference (0.8433 published prose). Unexpected positive requires escaping both arms.

adjudication_estimand.status: post-run adjudication amendment — NOT part of the exact pre-registered numerical rule
adjudication_estimand.criterion: usable independent decision: balanced canonical accuracy and balanced swap accuracy must each exceed 0.5 with a Wilson 95% lower bound above 0.5, and the full-set independent point estimate must exceed the locked 0.8502 reference
adjudication_estimand.why: The pre-registered phrase 'both-directions-correct also leaves chance' fixed no numeric null. Gating on joint both-correct against a fixed constant is not the intended estimand: the uncoupled baseline is p_canonical * p_swap, which equals 0.25 only when both marginals are exactly 0.5. Requiring each rendering's decision to clear chance is the directly interpretable reading of 'usable independent decision'.

reference_levels.both_correct_random_baseline_note: 0.25 is the accuracy of two independent fair-coin decisions both landing correct. It is an absolute random baseline only — not a universal null, not the null for this system, and not evidence of positive coupling. The uncoupled baseline is p_canonical * p_swap; the attainable ceiling is 1 - frozen_fraction. It is reported for orientation and is not the adjudication gate.
reference_levels.both_correct_cap_identity: both_correct <= 1 - frozen_fraction. A frozen pair answers the same side to both renderings while gold is mirrored, so exactly one is correct and both_correct is 0 for it.

verdict.full_control_comparison_note: Point-estimate comparison against the locked 0.8502 char-net reference. This is a conservative follow-up gate, NOT a paired superiority test — no significance is claimed either way.

balanced_coupling_diagnostic.status: secondary diagnostic — descriptive, not a test
balanced_coupling_diagnostic.note: No inference is drawn from this comparison. Turning it into a claim requires a pre-specified paired bootstrap or permutation over pairs, which this analysis does not perform.

balanced_unfrozen_diagnostic.status: post-hoc, descriptive — not part of the pre-registered verdict
balanced_unfrozen_diagnostic.note: Conditioning on 'not frozen' is chosen after seeing the frozen share. On unfrozen pairs canonical_correct == swap_correct holds identically, so this equals independent canonical accuracy there.

verdict.degeneracy_note: Secondary descriptive operationalization: fires when |antisym_accuracy - independent_canonical_accuracy| on the full discordant cell is >= 0.1 while that cell's independent Wilson interval still includes 0.5. The 0.1 threshold is descriptive and is NOT part of the primary pre-registered success/failure adjudication. It is recorded alongside the primary outcome and never replaces or modifies it.
verdict.decision: ceiling_holds: the run did not meet the adjudication criterion for a usable independent decision, and its full-set independent point estimate did not approach the locked 0.8502 reference. This is an adjudication label, not proof that all relational information is absent. stop_training stays true.
claim_boundaries: not a continuation of the locked 2/3/4/6/8-epoch curve
ceiling_holds is an adjudication label, not proof that all relational information is absent

interpretation: The run did not meet the adjudication criterion for a usable independent decision, and its full-set independent point estimate did not approach the locked reference. On the train-matched prose rendering the balanced slice gives canonical `0.5487` and swap `0.5325`, neither clearing `0.5` from above, and full-set independent `0.5674` is far below the v4 char-net reference `0.8502` and the locked prose reference `0.8433` — a point-estimate comparison, not a paired superiority test. Starting from a fresh LoRA with no glyph exposure therefore did not yield a single-pass decision this protocol would accept. That is an adjudication outcome, not proof that the model holds no relational information — failing to reject chance is not evidence of absence, and the post-hoc unfrozen-subset diagnostic is descriptive and does not reopen training.
